name: Youth Forest Council
org: City of Austin, Austin Climate Action and Resilience (Urban Forest Program)
what_you_do: This is a yearlong paid internship. It is with the City's Urban Forest Program. You help plan community events. You design education materials about trees. You represent the program in your neighborhood.
who_can_apply: Young people ages 16 to 20 who live in the City of Austin or its extraterritorial jurisdiction and are eligible to work legally in the U.S. No academic requirements.
pay_detail: $22.05 per hour, about 10 to 15 hours per month
duration: One year, June to May; one full council meeting a month
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 cohort were due March 15, 2026. The page says applications open again in January 2027.
how_to_apply: Online application (about 1.5 hours), short-answer questions, and one reference who completes a recommendation form. Accepted members become City of Austin employees and must verify work eligibility.
notes: Meetings are held at locations around Austin and transportation help may be available.
